CREATE TABLE "public"."application" (

CREATE TABLE "public"."auditLog" (

  "beforeState" text,

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."billShare" (
  "amount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "billId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "daysOccupied" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentId" text,

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."dispute" (

  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "raisedById" text NOT NULL,
  "resolution" text,
  "resolvedAt" timestamptz,
  "resolvedById" text,

  CONSTRAINT "dispute_status_check_0cd47f74" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'RESOLVED', 'DISMISSED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documentAuditLog" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documentSignature" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" text,
  "signatureUrl" text,
  "signedAt" timestamptz,
  "signerId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "documentSignature_status_check_1f857ff4" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'SIGNED', 'DECLINED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lease" (
  "billingCycle" text DEFAULT 'MONTHLY' NOT NULL,
  "billingDayOfMonth" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "propertyId" text NOT NULL,
  "rent" int4 NOT NULL,
  "roomId" text NOT NULL,

  CONSTRAINT "lease_status_check_b7e86225" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'ENDED', 'TERMINATED'))

CREATE TABLE "public"."leaseTenant" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isPrimary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "leaseId" text NOT NULL,
  "leftAt" timestamptz,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."maintenanceRequest" (

CREATE TABLE "public"."room" (
  "availableFrom" timestamptz,

  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "score" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "user2Id" text NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE "public"."roommateProfile" (

  "budgetMax" int4,
  "budgetMin" int4,

  "roomId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'REQUESTED' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
